description: Fix environment variable sync issue (#187) - update .env.shared to document all variables actually used in the codebase, remove truly unused variables, and ensure the check-env-sync.sh script passes cleanly. Also add missing variables referenced in config.py that are not in .env.shared.
steps: Run the check-env-sync.sh script to identify undocumented and unused variables: bash .github/scripts/check-env-sync.sh
For each UNDOCUMENTED variable (used in code but missing from .env.shared): add it to the appropriate section in .env.shared with a descriptive comment and placeholder value

For truly UNUSED variables in .env.shared: verify they are not referenced anywhere (including wrangler.toml, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, workflow files). If truly unused, add a comment marking them as deprecated OR remove them if they serve no purpose.

Ensure these variables from config.py are in .env.shared if missing: CF_AI_MODEL, ADMIN_JWT_SECRET, RESET_TOKEN_SECRET, INDEXNOW_API_KEY, INDEXNOW_INTERNAL_SECRET, CLOUDFLARE_KV_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, CLOUDFLARE_KV_NAMESPACE_ID, INDEXNOW_KEY, TRANSLATE_CRON_SECRET
Run check-env-sync.sh again to verify it passes (exit 0)
acceptance_criteria: All variables in config.py Settings class have corresponding entries in .env.shared
.env.shared is well-organized with clear section headers and comments
verification: Run: bash .github/scripts/check-env-sync.sh and confirm exit code 0
Run: python3 -c "from app.config import Settings; print('OK')" from apps/backend/ directory with minimal env vars
